recipes.name: Peanut Butter Curry Soup
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onions, garlic, and ginger for 3 minutes. Add splashes of water as needed to deglaze the pot.
Add the spices, stirring to toast for 30 - 60 seconds until fragrant.
Add the broth, sweet potatoes, banana, carrot, and peanut butter. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover with a lid, and cook for 15 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, and blend using an immersion blender or standing blender. Heat through completely.
Serve with bread or croutons, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † If desired, you can substitute 1 cup of vegetable stock with ½ vegetable bouillon cube plus 1 cup (240 mL) water. † Avoid using a ripe banana (one with brown spots) as the flavour is too potent. A firm, yellow banana is best for this recipe.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days, or in the freezer for up to 1 month.
